concepts.prompt: A fisher's shoulder bag made of knotted cream rope netting, with a few round cork floats tied along it and a large spiral seashell in teal and cream, a thick braided rope shoulder strap looping above. Bag only, nobody wearing it. Style: Palworld / Animo-class stylised game asset, chunky simplified readable silhouette that reads at 15 metres, slightly oversized key shapes, soft hand-painted PBR materials, warm natural palette taken from the reference key art (honey wood, warm brass and copper, slate blue, teal, mustard, moss green, cream). Single isolated object only, floating on a plain flat light-grey background, no ground, no shadow scene, no character, no body, no hands, no mannequin, no text, no logo. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon, no crimson, no pink anywhere. Show the same object from three views: front, three-quarter and side, consistent design.
references: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MJohnsonWellabe/Tetherbound/main/docs/reference/tetherbound-meadows-keyart.png (1536 x 1024 source re-encoded as JPEG q90 at 1536 px; local derived file keyart_1536.jpg): project palette and stylised finish
concepts.verdict: CHOSEN (view 0, front-three-quarter): cream knotted net bag, honey cork floats, a teal spiral shell, braided cream rope strap with brass rings

reference_inspection: Reference inspected before any prompt was written: docs/reference/tetherbound-meadows-keyart.png (Meadows key art: stylised Valheim/Palworld-like realism, honey timber, slate-blue roofs, moss greens, warm brass; its palette strip includes two oxblood swatches reserved for Team Tether, so every prompt banned red, oxblood, maroon, crimson and pink explicitly). Each prompt named the object only, on a plain background, with no character body or hands.
